hero.tagline: Colombian gaitas and drums music in Berlin

about.title: About Us
about.p1: A gathering space to preserve and spread the ancestral sound of the long gaitas from Montes de María.
about.p2: Gaita macho, gaita hembra, drums and maracas in their traditional rural format, open to new musical dialogues.
